definitions.gloss: tea gathering, tea ceremony event, tea party
definitions.explanation: A formal or semi-formal gathering where tea is prepared and served according to the traditions of Japanese tea ceremony ({茶道|さどう}). Can range from intimate sessions with a few guests to large-scale public events.

examples.japanese: {茶会|ちゃかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}かれた→招く：02425_maneku⟧。
examples.english: I was invited to a tea gathering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大|おお}{茶会|ちゃかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A large autumn tea gathering will be held in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧{茶会|ちゃかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧とき、⟦{作法|さほう}→作法：02825_sahou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わからず⟦{緊張|きんちょう}した→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{亭主|ていしゅ}→亭主：11470_teishu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: When I attended a tea gathering for the first time, I was nervous because I didn't know the etiquette, but the host kindly taught me.

notes:
USAGE:
{茶会|ちゃかい} refers specifically to gatherings centered on the Japanese tea ceremony (⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧). At a {茶会|ちゃかい}, the host (⟦{亭主|ていしゅ}→亭主：11470_teishu⟧) prepares ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧ (powdered green tea) and serves it to guests along with ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧ (Japanese sweets). Guests follow established etiquette for receiving and drinking the tea.

Larger public {茶会|ちゃかい} are often held at temples, parks, or cultural centers and are open to beginners.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶会|ちゃかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (hold a tea gathering)
- {茶会|ちゃかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧ (invite to a tea gathering)
- {大|おお}{茶会|ちゃかい} (large tea gathering / tea festival)
- {野点|のだて}{茶会|ちゃかい} (outdoor tea gathering)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧: the way of tea, tea ceremony (the art form itself)
- ⟦{茶席|ちゃせき}→茶席：29411_chaseki⟧: tea ceremony seat/session (the individual sitting where tea is served)
